title: Selection Sort
explanation: Simple in-place comparison sort that divides input into sorted and unsorted regions, repeatedly selecting the smallest element.

title: Radix Sort
explanation: Non-comparative integer sorting algorithm that distributes keys into buckets based on individual digits.

title: AVL Tree
explanation: Self-balancing binary search tree where the heights of the two child subtrees of any node differ by at most one.

title: Hash Map
explanation: Data structure implementing an associative array mapping keys to values using a hash function.

title: Bubble Sort
explanation: Simple comparison sort repeatedly swapping adjacent elements if in the wrong order.
